subject: Post-demo: feature coverage & CAC / $/1M token hypothesis
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Adam Lang <adam@elarahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: feature coverage & CAC / $/1M token hypothesis

Hi Adam —

Thanks again for the demo time this morning. Quick recap and the asks we discussed so we can turn this into a short commercial proposal: 

1) Token volume profile: can you confirm expected call/usage profile over the next 12 months (rough daily/monthly tokens, and any expected spikes tied to campaigns)? You mentioned pilots across 3 clinics — if you can split pilot vs. production day estimates that helps.

2) Budget bucket: you gave a range on the call (~$15k–$45k/month). Can you confirm if that is committed procurement budget or an internal target for evaluation?

3) Feature mapping: the team indicated two prioritized features — automated intake summarization (Feature A) and clinician-response suggestion (Feature B). If you can provide expected daily active users (DAU) per feature and average interactions per DAU that will let us compute $/feature.

4) Commercial targets: you mentioned a target CAC payback of ~9 months and a desired margin floor of 60% after inference. Is that still accurate? Also you called out a target unit price near $/1M tokens — you said $650–$800 as a strawman; please confirm.

Action for us: we’ll run a short unit-econ sketch ($/feature, tokens/feature, margin tailwind at proposed pricing) and return a one-page estimate + a tidy XLS with sensitivity ranges. Attached: a token estimate template (elara_token_estimates.xlsx) and a rough pricing sketch (redwood_pricing_sketch.pdf) to illustrate inputs.

Would you be able to send the token/day split and DAU estimates by EOD tomorrow? If not, Wed morning is fine — we want to get a pilot commercial back ahead of procurement review.

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0132

Attachment(s): elara_token_estimates.xlsx (stub), redwood_pricing_sketch.pdf (stub)

From: Adam Lang <adam@elarahealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@elarahealth.com
Date: 2026-08-04T10:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: feature coverage & CAC / $/1M token hypothesis

Hannah —

Appreciate the follow-up and the templates. Quick answers below while I dig up the DAU breakdown: 

- Pilot (first 90 days): ~3 clinics, estimated 1,200 interactions/day total across both features (~350k tokens/day).
- Prod ramp (6–12 months): expect to scale to ~12 clinics, ~5,000 interactions/day (~1.3M tokens/day) if pilot KPIs are met.
- Budget: current procurement signal is $25k/month for an initial 6-month pilot with optional expansion. That $25k is not a hard cap for production but the finance sponsor wants clarity on payback and line-item cost.
- CAC payback: target ~9 months — that's what leadership will sign up for.
- $/1M tokens: leadership internally suggested $700 as a starting point; they will want margin and risk mitigations to go lower if possible.

I'll attach the DAU breakout later today. For now, assume tokens/interaction avg = 300 (back-of-envelope).

— Adam
Adam Lang
Director, Product — Elara Health
adam@elarahealth.com

On Wed, Aug 4, 2026 at 09:12 AM Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai> wrote:

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-04T11:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: feature coverage & CAC / $/1M token hypothesis — quick unit-econ sketch

Hannah / Karthik —

Thanks — scribbling a quick sensitivity table based on Adam's roughs. Assumptions: tokens/interaction = 300, pilot interactions/day = 1,200, prod interactions/day = 5,000, target $/1M tokens = $700.

Pilot (1,200 interactions/day):
- tokens/day = 1,200 * 300 = 360k tokens/day (~10.8M tokens/month)
- monthly network/inference bill at $700 / 1M tokens = $7,560/month
- this is the raw inference line; add 20% for infra/ops/overhead (est) -> ~$9,072/month
- if customer budget = $25k/month, that leaves ~ $15.9k/month for product/CS/support + margin -> margin after inference ~64% (rough)

Prod ramp (5,000 interactions/day):
- tokens/day = 1.5M tokens/day (~45M tokens/month)
- inference bill = 45 * $700 = $31,500/month
- +20% overhead -> ~$37.8k/month
- if they expand budget proportionally, margin compresses; this is the key ask for pricing bands and eventual reserved capacity discounting.

$/feature estimate (very rough):
- Feature A (summarization): avg tokens/session 220 -> ~66k tokens/month per 1k sessions -> $46 / 1k sessions at $700/1M tokens (inference only)
- Feature B (response suggestion): avg tokens/session 420 -> ~$294 / 1k sessions at $700/1M tokens (inference only)

CAC payback check: if Elara expects incremental ARPU per acquired clinic of $8k/month, and CAC = $60k, payback 7.5 months — so product pricing and inference unit cost need to preserve that.

Next steps I propose:
- I'll build a two-sheet XLS: (1) pilot sensitivity (tokens/day, $/1M token bands: $900/$700/$500) and (2) production reserved pricing scenarios (commit levels and latency SLO tradeoffs).
- Hannah, can you confirm which margin floor Elara needs after inference to keep the business case intact? Adam said ~60% — if we target 60% we can back into $/1M tokens required at scale.

Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Attachment: (will attach sensitivity workbook in next email)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-04T15:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: feature coverage & CAC / $/1M token hypothesis — next steps and owners

Thanks Ben — this is exactly the framing we need for procurement. Two quick asks for the materials we send Adam / procurement: 

1) One-pager with three pricing bands: pilot (no commit), 6-month pilot (commit + minor discount), prod reserved (12-month commit with stepped discount). For each band show: monthly inference line, estimated overhead, net margin at their target ARPU, and breakeven CAC months.

2) Sensitivity XLS (Ben) with toggles for tokens/interaction, tokens/1M price, and a toggle for a 10%/20% usage spike. Keep formulas visible — procurement will want to run scenarios.

Owners: Ben — pricing sensitivity workbook + one-sheet economics. Karthik — prepare short note on reserved discounting ladder (bands and required commit levels). I'll coordinate procurement timing with Adam and loop in our legal for standard pilot T&C.

Goal: have a draft to share with Elara by Friday COB.

Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
